title: Janus Infinite Faces — Transformation, Canonicalization, and Provenance Continuity Test
problem: Portable content is routinely reformatted, normalized, translated, quoted, compressed or rendered into another file type. Exact byte identity and semantic claim identity must not be conflated.

identity_layers.CANONICAL_CLAIM_IDENTITY: Digest of a precisely defined canonical semantic payload.
identity_layers.DERIVATIVE_IDENTITY: New object derived from a verified parent by an explicitly recorded transformation.
identity_layers.DISPLAY_IDENTITY: Rendered appearance; not sufficient to establish the other identities by itself.

status_model.VERIFIED_EXACT_BYTES: Raw bytes match attested artifact digest.
status_model.VERIFIED_CANONICAL_CLAIM: Canonical payload matches attested claim digest under the declared canonicalization profile.
status_model.VERIFIED_DERIVATIVE: Transformation lineage from a verified parent is attested and the derivative is bound to its own digest.
status_model.UNVERIFIED_TRANSFORMATION: A changed object has no accepted transformation receipt or cannot reproduce the declared canonical relation.

canonicalization_rule: Canonicalization must be versioned, deterministic, narrow and mechanically replayable. It may normalize only transformations explicitly declared equivalent by the profile.
safe_normalization_examples: declared exclusion of presentation-only whitespace where the claim format defines whitespace as non-semantic
not_safe_to_assume_equivalent: changing numbers, qualifiers, negation or modality
reordering fields whose order is semantically meaningful

summary.rule: A summary may cite a verified source but cannot inherit the source claim digest.

ru: Одинаковый смысл нельзя объявлять доказанным только потому, что два текста похожи.
Байты могут измениться без изменения claim, но только узкая детерминированная canonicalization имеет право это утверждать автоматически.
Перевод и пересказ — потомки источника, а не сам источник.
en: Similar meaning is not a cryptographic primitive.
Bytes may change without changing a claim, but only a narrow deterministic canonicalization profile may assert that automatically.
Translations and summaries are descendants of a source, not the source itself.
